content.text:
## Execution Plan

**Phase 21: BYO IPFS Node Support** — 7 plans across 4 waves

| Wave | Plans | What it builds |
|------|-------|----------------|
| 1 | 21-01, 21-02 | SDK pinning abstractions + API CID registration |
| 2 | 21-03 | SDK client wiring with mode-aware upload |
| 3 | 21-04, 21-05 | Settings UI STORAGE tab + TEE pin migration backend |
| 4 | 21-06, 21-07 | Migration progress UI + performance benchmarks |

---

## Wave 1

**21-01: Pinning Provider Abstraction**
SDK-level pinning provider interface with KuboProvider (Kubo RPC) and PsaProvider (IPFS Pinning Service API) implementations, plus connection testing with protocol auto-detection and CORS validation. Foundation for all BYO-IPFS operations.

**21-02: CID Registration & Advisory Quota**
API endpoint for BYO users to report externally-pinned CIDs, plus advisory (non-enforced) quota tracking. Enables the lightweight API footprint where BYO users pin directly and just notify CipherBox.
